composite-driveway-gates.description: Composite driveway gates supplied and fitted in London. Compare board finishes, frame construction, opening options and the upkeep your chosen product needs.
sections: Choosing a composite gate for your entrance

Composite gates suit homeowners who like a boarded entrance and want an alternative to solid timber. Start with a sample of the proposed board and a drawing of the complete gate. The finish, gaps between boards and frame colour all affect how the entrance looks from the road and from inside your garden.

The word composite does not identify one specification. Ask for the board manufacturer, product name, frame material and fixing arrangement in your quotation. Compare those details before judging two gates by price. A decorative fence board and a gate system designed for repeated movement are different purchases.
Frame, boards and privacy

Discuss a closed-board design if screening matters, or a more open layout if you want to see approaching visitors. Ask the installer to assess exposure to wind along with the gate dimensions and supports. A solid entrance needs assessment as a complete structure, especially if you plan to add motors.

Confirm how the chosen boards attach to the frame, how the design allows for movement and how someone could replace a damaged board. Check the appearance of the rear face, exposed fixings and board ends on the drawing. These details can differ even when two quotations describe the same wood-effect colour.
Manual or automated operation

Your opening layout determines whether swing or sliding operation is practical. A survey should check the driveway gradient, parked-car positions, pedestrian route and room for the gate to move. For an electric system, the installer must assess the assembled gate, supports, controls and protective measures together.

Compare sliding gate options if space behind the entrance is limited. If you want to retain an existing gate, ask for an automation suitability assessment before buying a motor kit.
What your supply-and-fitting quote should include

Ask for the gate dimensions, board and frame specification, finish, posts or pillar work, hinges or running gear, locks, delivery and installation to appear in the written scope. An automated quotation should also identify the electrical work, controls, testing, handover and any surface reinstatement.

Check VAT, removal of the old gate and exclusions before comparing totals. Our installed gate cost guide provides a checklist you can use with each quotation.
Care and warranty terms

Composite does not mean a maintenance-free entrance. Follow the selected manufacturer’s cleaning instructions and arrange checks for the frame, hinges, locks and any automation. Ask which cleaning products and repair methods the supplier permits.

Get separate written terms for boards, frame and finish, installation workmanship and automation. Check who handles a claim, whether labour is included and whether maintenance records are required. We will confirm the terms for the proposed products in your quotation rather than apply one lifespan or guarantee to every composite gate.

If you prefer a metal finish, compare our aluminium driveway gates.

faqs.question: Do composite gates need maintenance?
faqs.answer: Yes. Follow the board manufacturer’s care instructions and maintain the frame, hinges, locks and any automation. The required work depends on the specified product and site conditions.

faqs.question: Can a composite gate be automated?
faqs.answer: It may be suitable after assessment of the complete gate, its supports, movement, wind exposure and surrounding entrance. Compatibility cannot be established from the board material alone.

faqs.question: How much do composite gates cost supplied and fitted?
faqs.answer: The price depends on the measured opening, boards, frame, finish, support work and manual or automated operation. Request an itemised site-specific quotation with VAT and exclusions stated.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with a composite gate?
faqs.answer: The quoted products and installation determine the terms. Ask for the cover, exclusions, maintenance conditions and claims contact for each part of the system before ordering.

aluminium-driveway-gates.description: Aluminium driveway gates designed, supplied and installed across London. Choose a finish and opening layout with the specification, installation scope and aftercare confirmed in writing.
sections: Aluminium gates for your London home

Choose the appearance of the entrance first: open bars, horizontal slats or a boarded design that provides more screening. Then compare the construction behind that appearance. Profile dimensions, joints, support posts and hardware matter as much as the colour.

Bring photographs of your frontage and examples of the look you prefer to the initial discussion. We can consider the driveway layout with you before specifying a gate. An existing pillar or a narrow entrance may need changes that a product photograph cannot show.
Choose the opening before ordering the gate

A swing gate needs a clear movement area inside the entrance. A sliding system needs suitable space along the boundary and a support arrangement designed for that system. The survey should account for gradients, drainage, parking positions and a separate route for people on foot.

Look at electric sliding gates and electric swing gates to compare the layouts. Avoid ordering from the width of the opening alone: the installer also needs to check supports, clearances and exposure.
Finishes, colours and samples

Ask for a sample and the exact colour reference for the proposed finish. Confirm whether the same colour applies to both faces, posts, hinges and other visible hardware. Wood-effect and textured finishes have their own product specifications and availability.

Check the manufacturer’s instructions for cleaning and dealing with scratches. Aluminium still needs appropriate care, and a powder-coated finish does not carry one universal guarantee. Ask for the actual finish warranty and its exclusions, including the treatment of accidental damage and unsuitable cleaning products.
Manual gates and automation

For a manual gate, discuss the lock, handles, hold-open arrangement and ease of everyday use. For automation, ask the installer to select equipment for the assembled gate and site rather than using the material name as a shortcut for motor suitability.

Decide how residents, visitors and deliveries will enter. Our access-control options cover intercoms and other entry methods. The completed powered system needs site-specific protective measures, commissioning and a clear handover. HSE explains the safety considerations for powered gates.
Compare complete installed quotations

Ask each supplier to list gate construction, finish, posts, fittings, groundworks, electrical work, controls, installation and handover. Check which surfaces they will make good and who will remove the existing gate. Agree how changes to the scope will be priced.

Use the electric gate cost checklist to compare quotations on the same basis. If a boarded wood-effect appearance matters more than a metal finish, compare composite gates before deciding.
Aftercare and written cover

Keep the product details, care instructions, warranty documents and service records together. Ask who to contact for a problem with the gate, finish or automation, and whether a call-out or labour charge applies. Cleaning and hardware checks remain part of ownership even when you choose aluminium to reduce timber-finishing work.

faqs.question: Are aluminium gates maintenance-free?
faqs.answer: No. Follow the manufacturer’s cleaning instructions and check the finish, fittings and moving parts. Automated gates also need maintenance appropriate to the installed system and its use.

faqs.question: Can I choose any colour?
faqs.answer: Colour and finish availability depends on the selected manufacturer and range. Ask for a sample, colour reference, lead time and written finish specification before ordering.

faqs.question: Do aluminium gates have a 25-year guarantee?
faqs.answer: There is no universal 25-year guarantee for aluminium gates. Product, coating, hardware, automation and installation cover can differ. The written quotation should identify the terms that apply to your chosen system.

faqs.question: Are aluminium gates suitable for a windy driveway?
faqs.answer: Suitability depends on the gate size, amount of solid infill, supports, exposure and operating system. Ask the installer to assess the whole entrance before choosing the design.

hardwood-driveway-gates.description: Hardwood driveway gates for London homes, with the timber, construction, finish and installation details agreed for your entrance.
sections: Choose timber by specification and appearance

Discuss the grain, board layout and finish you want, then ask for the timber species and construction details in writing. Oak and iroko are examples to discuss; confirm availability for the proposed design. Ask about timber sourcing and request a sample before agreeing a finish.

Accoya is modified wood, not a hardwood species. If you compare it with hardwood, compare the complete gate construction, coating and care requirements rather than treating the names as interchangeable.
Allow for your driveway and everyday use

The survey should check the weight and size of the proposed leaves, supports, gradient, movement space and route for pedestrians. Discuss how you will hold a manual gate open and how you will secure it closed. If you want power operation, include a complete-system assessment in the specification.

For existing gates, our retrofit automation service starts with the condition and suitability of what is already there.
Finish and maintain the gate

Agree whether you want to retain the original colour with a coating or accept a weathered appearance. Follow the timber and coating suppliers’ instructions for cleaning, inspections and recoating. Site exposure and the chosen finish affect the work required; there is no single annual treatment rule for every gate.

Ask for separate terms for timber, finish, fittings and workmanship. A timber durability warranty does not establish the service life of hinges or motors. The manufacturer Accoya describes care for its own gate material; that guidance should not be applied to a different timber.
Agree the installation scope

Include posts or pillar alterations, fittings, old-gate removal and any automation or electrical work in your comparison. Check VAT, exclusions and aftercare. Our cost guide explains how to compare the complete quotation.

faqs.question: How long will a hardwood gate last?
faqs.answer: Species, construction, exposure, finish and maintenance all affect its condition over time. Ask for the specified timber and written warranty; we do not promise one lifespan for every hardwood gate.

faqs.question: Can hardwood gates be automated?
faqs.answer: A suitable system requires assessment of the gate, supports, weight, movement and surrounding entrance. Ask for the proposed equipment and any structural changes in the quotation.

faqs.question: Will I need to stain the gates every year?
faqs.answer: Use the care schedule for the selected timber and coating. Inspect the finish and follow that guidance rather than assuming the same annual schedule applies to every product.

wrought-iron-gates.description: Traditional-style metal driveway gates in London, with the actual metal, decorative details, protective finish and opening system specified in your quote.
sections: Traditional appearance with a clear material specification

Scrollwork, bars and decorative tops can suit a period frontage, but the description wrought iron does not establish what a newly made gate contains. Ask the fabricator to state the actual metal and construction. Keep that distinction clear when comparing a new fabricated gate with restoration of an older gate.

Bring photographs of existing railings, pillars and neighbouring details. Discuss the design and finish together, including the appearance from inside the property.
Survey supports, access and opening space

The gate and its supports need to suit the entrance. Check the condition of existing pillars, ground levels and the route people use on foot. Agree hinge or running-gear details, handles and locks. Discuss automation before fabrication so the design can accommodate the selected equipment.

If you want to keep an existing gate, request a repair assessment before deciding to replace it. Structural condition and access requirements should guide that decision.
Protect the finish and plan aftercare

Ask for the proposed surface preparation and protective coating system in writing. Confirm how to inspect it and deal with damage. Avoid assuming that all metal finishes need the same treatment or that any coating removes the need for maintenance.

For an automated entrance, include system-specific servicing and handover instructions. Obtain written warranty terms for the gate, coating, installation and motors.
Compare scope and check local restrictions

Include fabrication, finishing, delivery, supports, fitting and any electrical or access-control work in the quote. Review the installed cost checklist before comparing totals. Check the position with your local authority before altering a listed property or a boundary subject to local restrictions; the appearance alone does not establish permission.

faqs.question: Are new wrought-iron-style gates made from wrought iron?
faqs.answer: The name can describe an appearance. Ask the fabricator to identify the actual material and construction in writing, especially when comparing a new gate with an older iron gate.

faqs.question: Can you assess an existing metal gate for repair?
faqs.answer: We offer gate repairs and maintenance. Share photographs and the problem you have noticed so we can discuss an assessment. The condition of the gate and supports determines the options.

faqs.question: Does a protective coating remove the need for upkeep?
faqs.answer: No. Follow the coating supplier’s care instructions, inspect for damage and arrange appropriate repairs and system maintenance.

pedestrian-side-gates.description: Pedestrian and side gates for London properties. Plan a usable walking route with the opening, lock, privacy and fitting details suited to your entrance.
sections: Plan the route people use every day

A separate pedestrian gate can let you enter without opening the vehicle gate. Start with who needs access: residents, visitors, deliveries, children or someone using a wheelchair or pushchair. Discuss clear opening space, thresholds, the approach and room to operate the gate.

Measure the route with the proposed handles, hinges and stops in place. A catalogue leaf width does not tell you the clear space available after fitting.
Choose privacy, handles and a lock together

Compare open-bar and boarded layouts, then decide how someone outside requests access and how a person inside exits. Confirm the lock, latch, handle height and any closer as part of the complete design. A closer changes how the gate moves and needs assessment with the chosen hinges and latch.

If you want electronic entry, discuss power, compatible locks, permissions and what happens during a power failure. Our access-control service can help you plan visitor entry. Shared entrances and escape routes need a site-specific assessment.
Match the gate to its supports

The installer should assess the existing wall, fence or posts before specifying the fixings. Agree the opening direction, finished ground level and drainage around the entrance. Choose materials and finishes that suit the surrounding boundary and the care you can provide.
Get a complete fitting quotation

Ask the quote to identify the gate, frame or posts, lock, handles, closer if proposed, removal work and making good. Include electrical work if required and request the care and warranty terms. If you are also replacing the driveway gate, ask for separate line items so you can compare the combined project.

Use our gate quotation checklist for the wider entrance work, or discuss your side-gate requirements.

faqs.question: Can the pedestrian gate match my driveway gate?
faqs.answer: Discuss the material, finish, infill and visible fittings together. Matching options depend on the chosen range and the space available for the pedestrian entrance.

faqs.question: Can I use an intercom or keypad with a side gate?
faqs.answer: It depends on the lock, access-control equipment, power supply and exit arrangements. Confirm the proposed components and failure behaviour before ordering.

faqs.question: What width should a pedestrian gate be?
faqs.answer: Start with the people and equipment using the route, then assess the clear opening after fitting, approach space and threshold. Ask the installer to confirm suitability for your site and any applicable requirements.

commercial-gates.description: Commercial gate and access-control installation in London. Plan vehicle movement, pedestrian access, operating frequency and maintenance around how your site works.
sections: Start with the way your site operates

Record the vehicles using the entrance, busiest arrival periods, opening hours and who authorises access. Include deliveries, visitors and staff on foot. Those requirements help establish whether a gate, barrier or separate pedestrian route suits the site.

Our commercial gate directory covers industrial gates, school entrances, car-park barriers and heavy-duty sliding systems. Use it to find the service closest to your project.
Specify the whole entrance

Discuss clearances, swept paths, queueing space, supports, power and access equipment during the survey. The proposed system needs to suit the expected pattern of use; a residential product description alone is not a commercial specification.

Confirm how staff manage credentials, how visitors request entry and how authorised people gain access when equipment fails. Keep emergency access and pedestrian movement in the site assessment.
Agree responsibilities and handover

Name the person responsible for the gate after installation and agree the training, instructions and records they will receive. Include maintenance arrangements and the procedure for taking faulty equipment out of use. HSE sets out responsibilities for powered gates.
Compare commercial quotations

Compare the gate or barrier specification, civil work, power, access controls, commissioning, handover and maintenance provision. Ask the contractor to identify exclusions, working-hour restrictions and any work required from other trades. Agree the acceptance and payment stages before installation.

For an existing faulty entrance, use our gate repair service. For a new project, send your site requirements to discuss the next step.

faqs.question: How do I choose a commercial gate system?
faqs.answer: Assess the vehicles, pedestrians, operating frequency, security needs, site layout and access arrangements together. Specify the equipment after that assessment rather than choosing by opening width alone.

faqs.question: Can you include access controls?
faqs.answer: Discuss the required intercom, keypad, phone-entry or number-plate system alongside the gate. Confirm compatibility, power, connectivity and any subscription or administration requirements in the quotation.

faqs.question: Who looks after the gate once installed?
faqs.answer: Agree a responsible person, handover records and maintenance arrangements before completion. Workplace gate owners and those responsible for the premises should understand their responsibilities and fault-reporting procedure.

electric-sliding-gates.description: Electric sliding gates designed around your London driveway, side space, supports and access requirements.
sections: Make room for the whole gate

Sliding gates move alongside the entrance, which can help where a swing leaf would conflict with parked vehicles. The survey must measure the full travel path, supporting arrangement and separation from walls, fences and pedestrian areas.

Tracked, cantilever and telescopic configurations need different space. Ask for a drawing showing the clear opening, stored gate and any supporting tail. An opening-width-plus-500-mm rule does not fit every design.
Check levels, supports and drainage

Tell us about slopes, standing water and work planned for the driveway. The proposed support and travel arrangement must suit the ground and gate dimensions. Include foundations, track where applicable, cable routes and surface reinstatement in the written scope.

For restricted sites, compare telescopic gates with the wider swing and sliding options.
Specify access and safe movement

Choose the appearance, privacy and opening arrangement alongside visitor entry and pedestrian access. A powered gate needs assessment of the entire movement area, including the run-back zone. Request the proposed protective measures, checks and user instructions.

Agree manual-release arrangements, maintenance access and the actual operating sequence. Opening speed depends on the equipment and safe configuration; it is not a universal service promise.
Request a complete quotation

Send your postcode, photographs and approximate opening dimensions. We can discuss a survey and the work required. Confirm products, groundworks, electrical supply, controls, VAT, exclusions and handover in writing.

Use our installed gate cost guide to compare proposals. Ask for the proposed lead time and the written terms for gate, finish, automation and installation before ordering.

faqs.question: How much side space does a sliding gate need?
faqs.answer: The required space depends on the tracked, cantilever or multi-panel design, supporting structure and protective clearances. Request a drawing of the complete travel and stored position.

faqs.question: Can a sliding gate work on a slope?
faqs.answer: A survey must assess the travel path, levels, drainage, supports and safe manual movement. A sloping driveway does not automatically favour a particular sliding design.

faqs.question: How long will installation take?
faqs.answer: Agree a programme after the measured design and groundworks are known. Fabrication, power and reinstatement can affect the schedule.

electric-swing-gates.description: Single and paired electric swing gates planned around your opening, parking space and everyday access.
sections: Plan the path of each leaf

A swing gate needs space throughout its opening arc. The survey should show the actual hinge position, leaf length, parking position and pedestrian route. A pair of leaves shares the opening width, but that alone does not establish safe vehicle clearance.

Use our layout comparison to prepare for the survey. Where space is tight, compare sliding and folding alternatives before selecting the gate design.
Check gradients and boundaries

Rising ground can conflict with the swing path. The installer must assess levels and the way a released leaf can move under gravity or wind. A different motor does not remove a geometry problem.

Check the highway boundary and relevant planning requirements before choosing outward operation. Read our outward-opening gate guide and obtain advice for the actual property.
Choose the gate and automation together

Compare material, infill, supports and exposure alongside the proposed drive. Above-ground and underground operators have different installation and maintenance requirements. Ask for the product model and the basis for the proposed arrangement.

Include access controls, protective measures, completed-system checks and manual-release training in the scope. Keep the written user and maintenance instructions after handover.
Compare the complete cost

We can discuss design, supply and installation for your London property. Send photographs and approximate dimensions when you discuss your entrance.

Use the installed gate cost guide to compare gate fabrication, supports, electrical work, groundworks and reinstatement. Confirm the timetable, exclusions and separate warranty terms before accepting.

faqs.question: Should swing gates open inward?
faqs.answer: The site layout, boundary and highway requirements need checking. Do not let a proposed leaf sweep over a public pavement or road without resolving the legal and safety implications with the relevant authority.

faqs.question: What width should I choose?
faqs.answer: Measure vehicle turning, the clear opening, supports and pedestrian use. A standard width cannot establish suitability for every driveway.

faqs.question: Are swing gates always cheaper than sliding gates?
faqs.answer: Compare complete quotations for your entrance. Supports, groundworks, gate design and controls can change the relative cost.

wooden-driveway-gates.description: Timber driveway gates for London homes, with the species, construction, finish and upkeep agreed before ordering.
sections: Choose the timber and appearance

Start with a sample and a drawing of the complete gate. Compare grain, board layout, frame proportions and how the finish will look beside the house. Ask for the species or modified-wood product in the quotation.

Hardwood, softwood and modified timber describe different options, not a fixed lifespan. Availability, construction and exposure matter. Our Accoya guide explains the difference between material and gate warranties.
Plan construction and automation

Discuss the dimensions, joints, supports and hardware with the installer. A timber gate can be considered for automation after assessment of its condition, geometry, dimensions, exposure and surrounding hazards. Motor selection involves more than weight alone.

Confirm which work the proposal includes for hinges, posts, power and protective measures. Where you are replacing an existing gate, compare the cost of retaining or renewing the supports.
Agree the finish and care

Choose whether you want a painted finish, visible grain or a changing weathered appearance. Request the coating system and care instructions for the selected timber and exposure.

Confirm the separate terms for timber, fabrication, coating, hardware and installation. A material guarantee does not automatically include repainting or call-out labour. Ask how maintenance affects those terms.
Compare your options

Use our wooden and aluminium comparison if you are also considering wood-effect metal. Compare samples and complete scope rather than a universal durability claim.

Send your postcode, preferred design and entrance photographs to discuss your entrance. We will discuss the proposed work and written quotation.

faqs.question: How long do wooden gates last?
faqs.answer: Condition over time depends on the timber, construction, finish, exposure and care. Request the proposed product specification and terms rather than relying on a universal number of years.

faqs.question: Can wooden gates be automated?
faqs.answer: Potentially, after assessment of the complete gate, supports, geometry and hazards. Motor capacity alone does not establish suitability.

faqs.question: Which timber should I choose?
faqs.answer: Compare samples, construction, finish care and the written terms for the available species or modified-wood product.

metal-driveway-gates.description: Compare metal driveway gate designs, fabrication and finish options for your London entrance.
sections: Specify the actual metal

A traditional iron-style appearance may use modern steel, while other designs use aluminium. Ask the quotation to identify the material, sections, joints and infill. Appearance alone does not establish what the gate is made from.

Compare open bars with a more screened design, considering the view from both sides and the surrounding frontage. Our slat-gate guide covers spacing and sightlines.
Ask how the finish protects the gate

Request the preparation and coating specification, including joints, edges and areas affected by fabrication. Galvanising, painting and powder coating are different processes; confirm which apply to the proposed gate.

No blanket rust-proof or maintenance-free promise replaces that specification. Ask for cleaning and inspection instructions, repair options and written coating terms. Compare physical colour samples before ordering.
Match the layout to the site

Choose swing or sliding operation around space, levels, supports and daily access. The dimensions and infill affect exposure and the requirements for powered movement. Include protective measures and maintenance access in the design.

If you have old metal gates, consider a restoration assessment before replacement. Listed or protected boundaries need their own checks.
Compare the written scope

Discuss aluminium or other metal options using the same opening and design requirements. The quotation should identify fabrication, supports, groundworks, controls, VAT and reinstatement.

Send your entrance photographs and postcode when you discuss your entrance. Confirm products and warranty terms in writing before ordering.

faqs.question: Are all metal gates galvanised?
faqs.answer: Do not assume so. Confirm the actual metal and preparation/coating system in the quotation.

faqs.question: Can you restore an existing iron-style gate?
faqs.answer: A specialist needs to identify the material, condition and repair scope before advising whether restoration is suitable.

faqs.question: Are metal gates maintenance-free?
faqs.answer: No. Follow the supplied care instructions for the finish, fittings and any automation.
